articles.summary: St-Patrice-de-Beaurivage, Québec – March 17, 2026 – Solugen Global Inc. (“Solugen” or the “Company”), a pioneer in sustainable agriculture solutions, is proud to announce a $50 million equity commitment led by Idealist Capital, a leading Canadian growth equity fund, with the participation of Canada Growth Fund Inc. (“CGF”). As part of this transaction, CGF is pleased to commit $20 million to support the next phase of Solugen’s growth. The new funding will accelerate Solugen’s production capacity
articles.title: Solugen Raises $50 Million to Scale Production of Azogen, a Fast-Release Fertilizer Certified for Organic Farming
